name: Diamond Electric Mfg. Corp
old_description: We deliver fantastic products and are committed to quality through dedicated teamwork.
about:
Diamond Electric Mfg. Corp traces its roots to 1937 when Inosuke Tomita founded Diamond Electric in Japan. The company established its U.S. presence in 1990 with Nobu Hashimoto as the first president of Diamond Electric United States (DEUS). After a groundbreaking ceremony in April 1996 attended by then-Governor Gaston Caperton, the Eleanor, West Virginia plant began mass production of ignition coils in May 1997. The corporate headquarters remains in Eleanor, WV, while a sales and design center operates in Farmington Hills, Michigan, near Detroit’s automotive hub.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes automotive electrical components, specializing in ignition coils for original equipment manufacturers. Its U.S. operations encompass manufacturing at the Eleanor facility, which has undergone multiple expansions since 1997, and engineering support from the Michigan center. Products are thoroughly tested to meet OEM standards, and the firm emphasizes research as a key step in new product development.

Diamond Electric serves three primary customer segments: global OEM automotive manufacturers, service part retailers, and DIY installers. Its ignition coils are supplied to major automakers, and the company has earned quality and delivery awards from several of them, including a President’s Product Quality Award from Subaru of Indiana Automotive in 2004.

The company’s stated philosophy—“We Are Diverse Shiny Diamonds. We Are Seeking the Happiness of Our Comrades, By Supporting Our Customers First, By Contributing to Society, With the Commitment to Earn Their Trust”—drives a quality policy focused on on-time, defect-free delivery and constant improvement through teamwork. Community involvement is also highlighted, with donations to local parks and schools in Putnam County.
